changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Funnel Analyst to Growth Experiment Planner handoff, reconciled cohort and stage-count artifacts, pending setup and executable checks.

title: Funnel and Conversion Intelligence
description: Turn an authorized signup-to-paid funnel change into a reconciled cohort observation and a bounded, owner-reviewed experiment proposal.
setup_prompt: Treat Funnel and Conversion Intelligence as a proposal. Inspect my product, funnel event and paid-state sources, existing Crews, metric definitions and owner. Propose reuse or creation of Funnel Analyst and Growth Experiment Planner, exact stage-count and experiment-plan validators, and one manual first run in Builder chat. Selecting the Playbook creates no Crew, event query, experiment, price change or schedule.

setup_inputs.label: Product, tenant, eligible cohort, ordered stages and owner
Event definitions/version, identity join, deduplication, consent and timezone
Authorized event and paid-state sources or exports with freshness and coverage
Comparable baseline/current windows or baseline-first choice, denominator and minimum quality rule
Change authority, primary metric, guardrail, sample and stop rule
Optional consented session evidence and sampling policy
Manual only or reviewed monitoring cadence, timezone and budget

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an approved missing Funnel or Experiment Crew with stable idempotency key and Workflow step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated funnel observation through a checked Workflow alias

recommended_tools.name: Product analytics MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized event definitions, unique-user stage counts, filters and freshness

recommended_tools.name: Subscription billing MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify paid status for the same eligible cohort and settlement cutoff

recommended_tools.name: Consented session replay
recommended_tools.purpose: Inspect sampled friction only when explicit consent and scoped access exist

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether funnel insight explains acquisition and conversion outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Reviewed Funnel and Experiment Crew roster and source/metric policy
Validated baseline/current unique-user stage counts with coverage and billing lag
Exact observation to pending experiment-plan handoff
Manual first run and paused repeat choice
